study.question: Observed validation evidence: g2-r0072-scorer_reference click AUC0.6675018907227037, prefix56 0.6670890456047657 (delta -0.000412845117938), second24 0.6653677985223699 (delta -0.002134092200334), both0.6656306700257453. These are successful executions with negative quality results, not execution failures. Prefix56 removed3472 parameters; p50 14.7773 vs14.9293ms and inference28.6164 vs29.1581s are about1.02%/1.86% lower, but train340.918 vs335.369s is slower; sequential same-seed timings do not establish a repeatable speedup. Earlier g2-r0024-joint_scorer_half also lost quality under a different parent and different RNG stream. Latest weighted and layout branches preserved AUC but offered no persuasive prediction-cost gain; do not erase them or adopt declared knowledge use as mechanism evidence. Source inspection shows prefix slicing retained full-template Xavier scales. Missing prior quantitative preservation threshold in this scoped workspace is not evidence it never existed; this follow-up freezes a conservative prospective guard and never retrospectively relabels old results. Can first-layer scorer width56 recover incumbent click quality and reduce measured prediction cost after controlling width-dependent initialization and a fixed alternative channel subset? Prospective selection, frozen before execution: require click AUC >=0.6673018907227037 (incumbent0.6675018907227037 minus0.0002), >= contemporaneous unchanged reference AUC minus0.0002, and >=0.666553547526167 (entry joint0.666753547526167 minus0.0002). If an accessible previously frozen criterion is stricter, retain it. Reproduce unchanged control AUC within1e-6 and prefix replay within1e-6 of their receipts; mismatch triggers reproduction diagnosis, not threshold relaxation. For provisional utility also require >=1% lower model p50 and >=1% lower full-validation inference time than current control, p95 no worse, and actual3472 fewer parameters. Confirm savings in complete repeated matched units; report all runtime noise and training cost separately. A one-run pass is preliminary, not statistical equivalence. No candidate qualifies on AUC or parameter count alone. Among qualified candidates choose lowest measured prediction time, then click AUC for ties within1%; all-task metrics/tradeoffs remain visible.
study.hypothesis: The first-layer prefix56 loss may partly reflect inherited full-width initialization rather than irreducible scorer capacity. Width-specific Xavier marginal variance, applied to the exact same fresh retained weights after all inherited construction, could preserve quality at56/32. A scaled suffix56 is a matched-parameter replacement testing sensitivity to which untrained channels survive. These are unverified local hypotheses; neither a scale rescue nor a successful suffix establishes all removed capacity redundant, generalizes across seeds, or identifies a new architecture.

Pinned Dice lines25-34 have affine=False BN and one-dimensional alpha; fixed-channel replacement slices alpha and running mean/variance together. Dice and downstream computation are inherited.

Exact source/receipt inspected. Prefix56 is replayed unchanged; new prefix changes only initialization scale, then scaled suffix changes only deterministic channel coordinates at the same effective widths. Previous second24/both losses are retained, not claimed refuted by a different intervention.
